title: Jollibee Barrel Man
description: A Jollibee-inspired barrel man at 65% scale. The body is about 133 mm tall. Both files are complete Bambu Studio projects for a Bambu X1C or X2D, in five PLA colors (red, yellow, cream, white, and black). Body and arms use 0.12 mm layers. The barrel sleeve uses 0.16 mm layers. Each project has four plates: the bee body, the barrel sleeve, both arms, and a spring insert with a fit coupon. The saved profile is the Bambu Lab X1 Carbon with a 0.4 mm nozzle. barrelman_complete_65.3mf is the wood barrel with black hoops (the wood tone is the cream filament). barrelman_complete_65_stripes.3mf is the red and yellow striped barrel with black hoops.
note: Jollibee is a trademark of its owner. This is an unofficial fan-inspired figure, not affiliated with or endorsed by Jollibee.
author: Jon D
